id./param/scenario/cs/b_080_cs_120.pack|cs_: "Is that the child?
"He has the Mark. No mistake...
"The Dark One drifts in the abyss of darkness, wrapped in freezing black shadow, and draws near the Mother Tree...
"The Luminary, bearing the Mark of Light, slays the Dark One with a holy sword and lights Erdrea with a flash...
"The final poem of the Book of Erdwin...
"The Book says the Dark One was destroyed by the ancient Luminary and the world became peaceful. But...
"You've all noticed monsters have multiplied across Erdrea compared to before?
"I hear Zwaardsrust, led by King Arnout, was attacked by evil monsters and fell.
"In such times, a child bearing the Luminary's Mark was born. What does it mean? I wish to hear the wise kings' views.
"You speak of an evil god and more monsters, but no matter what ominous shadow covers the world...
"A Luminary was born! As long as he lives, isn't the world's peace guaranteed?
"Ha ha ha! I see. As long as the Luminary lives, peace is guaranteed...
"...Lord Robert is wicked. In the Book of Erdwin you recited, the key part was missing, was it not?
"The opening poem, the first chapter of the Book of Erdwin. The prologue on the Luminary's birth.
"...The World Tree spins life, and from its breath is born the Luminary of light.
"The Luminary's endless light will in the end give birth to a black shadow: the Dark One, ruler of chaos...
"Then the Luminary himself gave birth to the Dark One...?
"As stars cannot shine without night's dark, darkness cannot exist without light. It is an order set since ancient times.
"Light and dark are always two sides of one coin. Is the Luminary's birth the Tree's blessing, or a sign the Dark One awakens?
"You go too far, King Gustaf! To equate the Luminary with evil!
"How can you be sure the Luminary is good? ...Ominous shadows are not only monsters.
"Recently, Erdwin's Lantern in the night sky has begun to glow dully. It happened with your son's birth.
"How dare you...!
"Waah! Waaaah!
"I hear it. In its ominous glow, Erdwin's Lantern sings a song of ruin leading Erdrea into chaos!
"...He has a point.
"King Carnelian...!
"Slowly but surely, ominous footsteps approach the world. Signs appear everywhere. That is true.
"As rulers, for all people of Erdrea, we must cut off the source.
"...Even if it is the Luminary.
"...Are you saying to kill this child?
"Just before my son {var:1} was born...
"A holy light rose from Yggdrasil and brightly lit the pre-dawn sky.
"Right after, resonating with it, {var:1} was born with a shining mark on his hand.
"This child is unmistakably the Luminary, a light of hope the Tree gave as power to dispel the great darkness.
"Light and dark are not two sides of one coin! The Luminary's holy light will surely dispel darkness. I believe it!
"Well said, Irwin! Had you agreed with us, we would have taken the Luminary at once!
"The Luminary {var:1} is Yggdrasil's will, a power of light given to us. We must protect him with all our might.
"Was that too cruel? I wanted to know your true heart. Forgive me, Irwin! Ha ha ha!
"Heliodor pledges support for the Luminary. When {var:1} turns sixteen, he will train in Heliodor.
"{var:1} must gain the power to guide us as soon as possible!
"King Carnelian, everyone... Thank you!
"All settled, then. I knew it would turn out so! Ha ha ha ha!
"Then the conclusion is reached. Our hearts are one!
"All as Yggdrasil wills!
"Now the Colloquy is over. Show {var:1}'s face to those awaiting the Luminary.
"King Carnelian...! Thank you...!
"...Then, everyone, thank you for your long attendance. The Colloquy of Kings ends here...
"K-King Irwin...!
"What is it!?
"E-Everyone! Flee! Monsters have entered the castle...
"Gh-Guh...!!
"Everyone, disaster! Many monsters are coming here. Please flee!"
